user_request: Sensitivity analysis of each parameter to understand the practical importance of its estimation error.
question: Under specified future inputs, how much does each saved parameter/state error change predicted terminal voltage and propagated SOC, and how do errors cancel or interact?

model.OCV: Existing supplied illustrative U(z)=3+1.15z+0.08tanh(8(z-0.5)); no curve or temperature estimation.
model.parameter_evolution: Fixed for each forward trajectory; only z,v1-v3,h propagate.

semantics.scope: Future, state-conditioned open-loop deterministic point sensitivity; no estimator execution or voltage assimilation.
semantics.anchoring: Every protocol independently starts at each saved current-state anchor. This is six hypothetical follow-ups, not a new concatenated use history.
semantics.historical_effects: Holding current states fixed while changing a parameter excludes its effect on the preceding trajectory. Zero sensitivity here does not imply historical irrelevance or identifiability.
semantics.local_sensitivity: Analytic derivatives dV/dx and dz/dx with respect to the sixteen native entering coordinates, evaluated at both saved truth and estimated vectors.
semantics.normalization: Positive physical parameters use a1percent fractional DIFFERENTIAL at the relevant anchor: native log increment0.01 for first6 coordinates and0.01*p for linear positive R/H. This is a derivative scale, not an exact+1percent finite perturbation. All selected physical parameters must be positive; no relative-normalization floor.
semantics.state_units: Current SOC1percentage point (0.01 fraction), RC entering voltages1mV, h0.01 dimensionless. Relative parameter and absolute state units are labeled separately.
semantics.known_error_injection: For each coordinate, start from the saved scoring-truth vector and replace exactly that coordinate by its saved estimate. Other parameters/current states are held at scoring truth. Evaluate exact nonlinear trajectory difference.
semantics.counterfactual_repair: Start from complete estimated vector and replace one coordinate by scoring truth. Difference from unrepaired estimate is conditional marginal effect; it is not unique causal attribution or an implemented correction. Stored repair effect is V_original_estimate minus V_one_coordinate_repaired: the modeled error contribution removed, not repaired-minus-original. A large change need not improve total error.
semantics.joint_error: Complete estimated trajectory minus complete scoring-truth trajectory. Errors remain signed until peak/RMS reduction.
semantics.interaction: Joint error minus sum of exact isolated errors is the cross-coordinate remainder for this decomposition. Joint minus J_truth*error is total first-order approximation error. Neither is a certified interval bound. Joint_RMS/RMS(sum absolute isolated effects) is a scale diagnostic with no guaranteed[0,1]range; it is not a calibrated or bounded cancellation fraction.
semantics.SOC_outputs: Actual propagated SOC changes only with entering SOC and Q in this model. Other parameters can influence estimator SOC through voltage correction, which this offline forward calculation does not simulate.
semantics.SOC_proxy: Pointwise100*deltaV/OCV_slope(z_truth) is an OCV-equivalent SOC displacement with other voltage terms fixed. Peak taken after this division. It is not actual SOC error, estimator response or an error bound.
semantics.reference_voltage: 1mV is only the inherited per-sample noise scale used for reading effects, not an acceptance threshold. Repeated sub-noise effects may be informative; large responses may remain confounded.
semantics.sample_metrics: Peak includes t0 under the first protocol current; other values are end-of-interval samples. Later instantaneous current-switch limits are not inserted. RMS excludes t0 and weights all equal1/35s intervals equally. Peaks are grid-sampled, not continuous-time maxima.
semantics.plot_views: Metrics use every sample. Compact plot views retain each dwell first10s densely plus401 uniformly spaced indices and boundaries; final anchor only.
semantics.mixture: Propagation of the reported aggregate mean is a deterministic point diagnostic, not the predictive distribution or transported covariance of the full mixture.
semantics.ranking: Report per protocol and anchor. A maximum across the six declared protocols may summarize this fixed set, but is not a universal importance ranking, probability-weighted utility or certified bound.

metrics: Normalized local peak/RMS mV at truth and estimate anchors.
Exact known-error isolated peak/RMS/signed final voltage, time of peak, OCV-equivalent SOC proxy and actual propagated SOC.
Conditional one-coordinate repair effect and linearization residual.
Complete joint voltage/SOC errors, exact isolated signed sum, absolute-magnitude sum diagnostic, first-order sum and nonlinear interaction.
Changes from900 to1800 to2100s anchors; no monotonicity or capacity startup deadline.

prerequisites.reference: Unchanged production C physical model plus independent closed forms and central differences on short public fixtures; no saved CellB truth/estimate used in prerequisites.

guards: Freeze source, protocol plan, qualification and saved-evidence hash before evaluating the prescribed follow-ups.
Use saved truth only for post-inference comparisons; never change estimator initialization, inference, priors, noise, weights or existing results.
Check physical domains for every trajectory; preserve started receipt and execution failure, stop on invalid input/domain/nonfinite results. No clipping or adaptive shortening.
Preserve original35Hz observations, timing and state; this analysis never alters or assimilates them. New diagnostic protocols have their own declared uniform intervals.
No inference that sensitivity equals observability, Fisher information, coverage or a posterior probability. No independent-precision addition or repeated-observation assimilation.
No estimator SRAM added; analysis arrays and plots are offline costs, not an embedded implementation or target qualification.
finish_line: One frozen offline analysis and one evidence-backed interpretation of which remaining errors matter for voltage/SOC under each declared use regime, including cancellations and unresolved downstream effects. Stop without parameter pruning, tuning, new learner runs or a horizon sweep.
afterward: Use sensitivity findings to sharpen the continuous learning/retention validation contract. The previously proposed24h pilot is not executed or qualified by this analysis.
